emily.docs: holding PR #4190 (batching examples + migration guide) until platform confirms server defaults. preview shows different behavior than snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4190
ci-bot: docs-preview: failed 6a8 snapshot mismatch on /guides/optimization (build 801)
ryan.sdk: can you paste the snippet you used? is this the SDK auto-batching example?
emily.docs: yep, i used the JS snippet in the new section:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ key: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-medium',
  input: 'summarize this',
  auto_batch: true
});
```
preview shows single-request behavior in hosted preview (no batching), while the guide text claims "server will batch small requests by default when auto_batch=true"
meera.platform: short answer: server-side batching is enabled by default, but the SDK's `auto_batch` flag currently defaults to `false` in the 1.x released SDKs. hosted runtime will only batch when the client advertises batching. so there's a mismatch between the docs and the shipped SDK default.
ryan.sdk: confirming  SDK default: `auto_batch: false` for JS/TS and Python 1.x. planned change in sdk@2.0 to default to true but that's not released.
alex.qe: this is blocking for the docs because a customer following the migration guide will be surprised. we should either change the docs to call out current SDK defaults OR hold merge until the new SDK ships.
emily.docs: i'd prefer to put a clear note in the guide: "As of SDK 1.x, auto_batch defaults to false; set auto_batch:true to opt in. SDK 2.0 will flip the default." that will unblock merging.
meera.platform: also important: server batching has three server defaults that matter in examples: `batch.max_size=64`, `batch.max_tokens=2048`, `batch.window_ms=10`. these are the hosted defaults and can be overridden by Dedicated configs or per-route policies. please quote those exact values in the docs.
ryan.sdk: adding to that: the SDK also exposes `batch_hint` where you can request a preferred `max_batch_size` which the runtime honors when possible. snippet for docs:```js
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-medium', input, auto_batch: true, batch_hint: { max_batch_size: 32 } });
```
ci-bot: docs-preview: rebuild requested for PR 4190 (build 802)
devops-bot: triggered preview build 802. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/802 :robot_face:
ci-bot: docs-preview: success (build 802) :tada:
emily.docs: updated the PR to explicitly call out: (1) current SDK defaults (1.x), (2) hosted server batching defaults, (3) Dedicated can override. also added the batch_hint example and a short FAQ note re: migration to SDK 2.0. assigning reviewers: @ryan.sdk, @meera.platform. holding merge for one approval.
ryan.sdk: approved, nit on wording around `batch_hint` but fine.
meera.platform: approved. small addendum: note on latency tradeoff: increasing `batch.window_ms` may increase throughput but adds tail latency; added sentence.
emily.docs: merging after squash. thanks folks. :sparkles:
